newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Nine die from poisonous mushrooms in Romania.
newsitem.headline: Nine die from poisonous mushrooms in Romania.

text.p: Nine people, including three children, have died after eating poisonous mushrooms in northern Romania, state television said on Wednesday.
Doctors in a hospital in Baia Mare, near the border with Ukraine, told television that they had treated 62 cases of poisoning in the past two weeks. Most of those affected were children.

Instances of poisoning occur regularly in post-Communist Romania, where hard-pressed consumers view mushroom picking either as a cheap way to feed their families or a chance to earn easy money at markets.
Romanian television has in past years launched campaigns warning consumers to buy only mushrooms grown in greenhouses.
